mapper.select: SELECT n.notification_id AS id, n.notification_title AS title, n.notification_content AS content, CASE WHEN n.status_id = 7 THEN FALSE -- 읽지 않음 WHEN n.status_id = 8 THEN TRUE -- 읽음 END AS isRead, n.notification_created_at AS createdAt FROM notification AS n WHERE n.notification_received_member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY n.notification_created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
